description: No clean concept; likely a mixture. Fires mostly in early-to-middle games as a weak sum of cues: my stones at the bottom of columns 2 and 4, their stones at the bottom of columns 3 and 6 (column 6 otherwise empty), and their two or three stones stacked on my pair in column 5. My stone at the bottom of column 5 suppresses it. Depends strongly on move order, not just the board.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.04 on 5 positions.
notes: 3 score calls. p1 bottom-row rule F1 0.17; p2 hand-weighted additive cell score F1 0.227 (P 0.20, R 0.27, AUROC 0.62, sim share 0.03); p3 column motifs from minimal pairs F1 0.19. Same board with different move order gives 3.29 vs 1.74. Column motifs are column-specific (their vertical three on my pair: col5 3.9, col3 -0.1). Best synthesis 5.16 < dev max 5.98. Likely a random direction or a polysemantic mixture.
